sahil: Heads-up — ORD reserve pool started evicting GPUs ~15m ago. Attach-fail rate jumped to ~7% and p99 latency climbed 220ms -> 820ms. Autoscaler backfilled with spot nodes but we exhausted instance quota in one AZ. Opening this thread to discuss runbook updates for secondary backfill + cost guardrails. pinging infra oncall.
ops-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-3489 — https://incidents.redwood/INC-2026-3489
devon: Oncall here. Confirmed symptoms. Netlink shows partial egress asymmetry to ord-azb, not full region down. A subset of pods lost attach leases causing retries. We've started shifting some weight to ord-azc (ORD2) but want a controlled plan for fanout to AMS if ORD degrades further.
anita: We currently have a basic weighted-routing script. Proposal: add a 'secondary_backfill' stage that triggers when attach_fail_rate > 3% AND reserve_pool_utilization > 85% for > 5m. Also enforce a cost cap guard: if projected incremental cost > $5k/hr, pause and require oncall approval. I'll write the playbook PR.
jia: Strong +1 for a dry-run step. Before a full fanout we should shadow 1% of traffic to fallback region to validate KV cache warmup and model-variant compatibility. Add a test step in the runbook.
marc: Cost note — last major fanout resulted in ~$18k/day in extra spot + egress. If we do cross-region fanout during quota pressure that's expensive. Suggest a 'budget leash' that reduces batch_size and lowers priority classes before initiating cross-region routing.
leah: Quick command that helped during mitigation (for ops reference):

```bash
curl -X POST https://routing.redwood/api/v1/shift \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ROUTE_TOKEN" \
  -d '{"from":"ord","to":"ams","pct":15}'
```

We used a 15% incremental shift to relieve attach pressure for ~10m.
devon: Adding to that — implement a staged fanout policy: steps [5, 15, 50] pct with 2m cooldown between steps and automatic rollback TTL of 20m if attach_fail_rate doesn't improve. Also add a pre-check: fail if instance quota < required_backfill_capacity.
sahil: Proposed action items (tl;dr):
- anita: PR playbook edits for 'secondary_backfill' + cost cap (owner)
- jia: implement dry-run shadowing harness + tests
- marc: define budget leash thresholds and run cost sims
- devon: add CLI script + staged fanout logic + pre-checks
- leah: collect and link logs from this run to S3 and add sample curl commands
Owners assign and target: EOD tomorrow. Reply with +1 to acknowledge.
anita: on it :white_check_mark:
jia: will write tests and CI job to run the dry-run harness
marc: i'll run sims against last 6 months of traffic and propose thresholds
leah: uploaded logs to s3://redwood-incidents/INC-2026-3489/ and added a short playback script

sahil: Thanks all. Two small extra asks for the PRs: include a cost-estimate table for common fanout sizes (5/15/50%) and a checklist item to run the shadow/dry-run before promoting to full fanout. We'll sync in tomorrow's infra retro to finalize wording.
